title: Al2O3/MgF2 17-layer defect cavity with stratified random initialization and perturbation
scientific_hypothesis: Breaking symmetric optical-thickness clusters through stratified random initialization (80-220 nm) followed by deterministic +/-12% perturbation will enable exploration of higher-frequency interference regimes that uniform 150 nm initialization cannot reach, improving target score beyond 0.3528.
design_principle: Single defect cavity in periodic Bragg stack creates narrow passband at defect resonance while surrounding quarter-wave pairs provide broad stopband. Stratified initialization prevents optimizer from converging to symmetric local minima.
proposed_topology: Air | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 (defect) | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | Fused silica. Total 17 finite layers, symmetric around center defect layer.
design_variables: All 17 layer thicknesses (optimizable, bounds 80-220 nm initial, then perturbed)
theory_basis: Transfer-matrix method for coherent multilayer interference
Defect mode resonance in 1-D photonic crystals
expected_advantages: Escapes symmetric local optima from uniform initialization
Maintains proven 17L topology while improving search diversity
Directly addresses feedback directive from iteration_02
known_risks: Perturbation may destabilize otherwise viable candidates
17L count may be insufficient for required visible/NIR blocking depth
execution_request_english: Optimize a 17-layer defect cavity filter on fused silica substrate using Al2O3 (high-index) and MgF2 (low-index) dielectrics. Layer sequence: Air | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 (center defect) | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | MgF2 | Al2O3 | Fused silica. Initialize all 17 layer thicknesses with stratified random distribution spanning 80-220 nm per layer. After first evaluation cycle, apply deterministic perturbation of +/-12% amplitude to break symmetry, specifically targeting layers converging near integer half-wavelength multiples. Optimize all 17 thicknesses for maximum transmittance in 255-280 nm band while suppressing transmittance in 300-700 nm and 700-1100 nm bands. Normal incidence, unpolarized illumination. Maximum 30 layers constraint satisfied (17 used). No metal layers. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 255–280 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Transmittance in 300–700 nm; Transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers; No metal layers; Only conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials.
revision_reason: Iteration_02 achieved 0.3528 target score with uniform 150 nm initialization. Feedback directive specifies stratified random 80-220 nm initialization with +/-12% perturbation to escape symmetric optical-thickness clusters. This route implements that exact change while preserving the 17L defect cavity topology.
